denied.title: This page is for competition managers
denied.body: Your account doesn't manage competitions. If it should, ask a super admin to give you the competition manager role.

notFound.title: There's no competition here
notFound.body: It may have been a mistyped link. The list shows every competition you manage.

meta.title: Competitions
meta.description: Create, edit, preview and publish competitions.

list.title: Competitions
list.lead: Drafts stay private until you publish them. Published competitions show on the public competition pages.
list.empty: No competitions yet. Start with a new one.

new.title: New competition
new.lead: A code and a name are enough to save a draft. Fill in the rest before you publish.

meta.title: Edit competition
meta.description: Change a competition's details, dates and categories.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.lead: Save as often as you like. A draft stays private; changes to a published competition show on its public page at once.

meta.title: Preview competition
meta.description: See a competition as visitors will, then publish it.

preview.title: Preview: {name}
preview.leadDraft: This is how the public page will show it. Nobody else can see it until you publish.
preview.leadPublished: This competition is published. This is what visitors see.
preview.problemsLead: Fix these on the edit page, then come back to publish.
preview.publishLead: Publishing puts it on the public competition pages straight away.

done.created: Draft saved. Keep filling it in, or preview it.
done.published: Published. It now shows on the public competition pages.

detail.publicDisplay: Artworks may be shown in public: {answer}

physicalArtwork.top_n: the top {count} of each category's shortlist

form.codeHint: 3 to 6 letters and the year's last two digits, like PAWS27. It goes into every registration number, so it can't change once published.
form.name: Name
form.welfareMessageHint: One or two sentences children read on the competition page.
form.whoAndWhat: Who takes part, and in what
form.ageGroupsHint: Ages are whole years on the cut-off date. Groups shouldn't share an age.
form.categoriesHint: Each category is one discipline for one age group. Untick any you won't run.
form.categoriesEmpty: Choose disciplines and add age groups to see the categories.
form.keyDatesHint: Enter every date and time in IST (India Standard Time).
form.schoolRoundHint: Only when schools and institutions take part.
form.physicalArtworkTopN: How many of each category's shortlist
form.publicDisplay: Artworks may be shown in public

physicalArtworkOptions.top_n: The top few of each category's shortlist

alerts.invalid_input: Some answers need fixing. Each one is marked below.
alerts.code_taken: Another competition already uses that code.
alerts.code_locked: This competition is published, so its code can't change.
alerts.invalid_date: A date needs fixing. Each one is marked below.
alerts.not_ready: This competition is published, so it can't have gaps. Each one is marked below.
alerts.not_found: This competition isn't there any more.
alerts.refused: Your account can't make this change.

errors.name: Enter a name.
errors.ageGroups: Give every age group its own label, and whole-number ages.
errors.categories: A category names a discipline or age group that isn't chosen.
errors.codeFormat: Use 3 to 6 letters and two digits, like PAWS27.
errors.codeTaken: Another competition already uses this code.
errors.codeLocked: The code can't change once published.
errors.date: This date doesn't exist. Check the day and month.

problems.ageGroupsNone: Age groups: add at least one.
problems.label_required: Age group {row}: give it a label.
problems.range_inverted: Age group {row}: the youngest age is above the oldest.
problems.age_out_of_bounds: Age group {row}: ages run from 3 to 99.
problems.label_duplicate: Age group {row}: age group {other} has the same label.
problems.overlaps: Age group {row}: it shares an age with age group {other}.
problems.unknown_age_group: Category {row}: its age group isn't there.
problems.out_of_range: {field}: this number is out of range.
